Поля: id, en, gruppa, avtor, pravilo (rule in one line), voznikaet (what tends to emerge), um (the cheapest mind that runs it), ssylka; у наших — stranica (путь от dizajner/) и zamechanie.

modeli.pravilo: a cell lives on with 2–3 live neighbours and is born with exactly 3
modeli.voznikaet: gliders, oscillators, patterns that travel and compute

modeli.pravilo: particles of a few kinds attract or repel each kind by its own force, and the forces need not be mutual
modeli.voznikaet: cell-like blobs, chasers and prey, membranes

modeli.pravilo: a cellular automaton with continuous space, time and state
self-copying programs share memory and processor time and mutate when they copy
modeli.voznikaet: parasites, hosts, an arms race — evolution driven by each other

modeli.pravilo: keep apart, match heading, stay close — only to neighbours you can see
an ant carrying food leaves scent; scent spreads and fades; others follow it
modeli.voznikaet: trails to the nearest food first, then to farther food

modeli.pravilo: agents with a metabolism and a range of sight gather sugar that grows back
modeli.voznikaet: inequality of wealth, migration; with extensions — trade and culture

modeli.pravilo: if too few neighbours are like me, I move
modeli.voznikaet: even a mild 30% wish gives neighbourhoods about 70% alike

modeli.pravilo: neighbours meet in proportion to how alike they are; one copies one trait of the other
modeli.voznikaet: alike nearby, divided overall — frozen cultural regions

modeli.pravilo: the bar is fun unless crowded; each guesses tonight's crowd in their own way
modeli.voznikaet: attendance hovers around the limit with no one coordinating

modeli.pravilo: sheep eat grass, wolves eat sheep; energy goes into offspring or runs out
modeli.voznikaet: without grass — extinction; with grass — populations rise and fall in waves

modeli.pravilo: black and white daisies warm or cool the ground; each grows best at its own warmth
modeli.voznikaet: the planet keeps its temperature steady — until the sun is too strong
a sharp threshold: at 55% density it dies out, at 59% it is a coin toss, at 70% it crosses

modeli.pravilo: the sick infect contacts with a chance, then recover and are immune
modeli.voznikaet: a wave and a threshold — it spreads or fizzles

modeli.pravilo: a win raises the chance of the next win, a loss raises the chance of the next loss
modeli.voznikaet: a pecking order: winner effect alone — a straight line; both — tangled, with cycles

modeli.pravilo: hawks fight, doves give way; a fight costs more than the prize
modeli.voznikaet: a steady mix of hawks and doves

modeli.pravilo: strategies play repeated give-or-take with each other; successful ones spread
modeli.voznikaet: tit for tat wins: kind, hits back, forgives, easy to read

modeli.pravilo: a language-model mind with a memory stream, reflection and a day plan

modeli.pravilo: a retold story carries the teller's reading, not the fact; memory is unreliable
modeli.voznikaet: rumours, reputations, legends that drift toward a few shapes

two inhabitants with a language model; the world is physics. They invented a water deal and a watering queue
villages copy neighbours and the state's norm; dialect lines are sharp and shift by era
four AI inhabitants with clashing wishes; body in code every tick, mind when needed. Needs its own server (sosedi/dolina/zapusk.command)
